svg.aria-label: Two line charts and a bar pair. Against coupling strength 0 to 0.32, temporal XOR on the tensor stays between 0.995 and 1.000 and classification between 0.858 and 0.875. Against decay 0.5 to 0.995, XOR stays between 0.995 and 1.000. Removing the tanh nonlinearity drops XOR from 0.995 to 0.531.

g.text: dashed tick: chance for the task · whisker: ± 1 sd over three seeds
XOR (pink) is solved with the neighbours disconnected, k1 = 0; classify (teal) barely moves. The hatched bands are
each task’s gain over raw samples.
cutting λ from 0.995 to 0.5, so a state halves every slot, leaves XOR at 1.000.
take the per-slot tanh out and XOR falls to 0.531, a coin toss with a wide spread.
